title: 2025 election challenge and High Court remand
text: Challenge to the DR decision discarding the 22 March 2025 election. On 1 August the High Court quashed the DR order and remitted for fresh determination.

fields.parties: PHAOA and Vinod Negi; connected petition by Sandeep Sharma and 17 others v State of UP and others
fields.forum: Allahabad High Court / Deputy Registrar / Prescribed Authority
fields.prayers: Judgment reproduces two main prayers: quash DR order dated 15 May 2025; direct DR to recognise the 22 March 2025 election. This is the 2025 writ, not the current 2026 petition.
fields.outcome: DR order set aside; both writs allowed with remand and hearing of both sides, preferably eight weeks from receiving certified copy. It does not finally resolve all electoral objections.
fields.missing: Full petitions/annexures, DR orders, result/attendance records, certified-copy receipt trail.

title: 2026 SDM decision, High Court order and correction
text: Challenge to April 2026 action. On 13 May the HC set aside the 24 April SDM order and directed a fresh reference-maintainability decision; it addressed the election restraint, bye-laws and a consequential DR order. The dispute reached SDM Dadri through DR letter 6021 of 25 August 2025 under Section 25(1).

fields.parties: PHAOA and Vinod Negi v State, Deputy Registrar, Prescribed Authority/SDM and Anuj Kumar
fields.prayers: Full petition unavailable. Judgment identifies challenges to 24 April and 29 April orders; do not present reconstructed requests as the complete filed prayer clause.
fields.outcome: One month for reference decision from production of certified copy, followed by elections within one month of that decision. 20 May correction fixes three dates. September dismissal is news-reported; original unavailable.
fields.missing: April SDM/DR orders in full; complete petition, stay application, certified-copy production, September decision and October officer directions.

title: Builder cheque complaint and quashing application
text: Section 138 NI Act summons dated 27 August 2025 challenged. HC order records a monetary dispute and possibility of compromise.

fields.parties: Smt Anjali Negi and two others v State and another; underlying Panchsheel Buildtech v Panchsheel Hynish Apartment and others
fields.forum: ACJM Court 3, Ghaziabad / Allahabad High Court
fields.prayers: HC application sought quashing of summons and entire underlying proceeding. This is stated in the order; full application and complaint unavailable.
fields.outcome: Disposed with a conditional route to seek compounding, deposit 10% of cheque amount and time-limited protection. Cheque amount, later payment, settlement or trial outcome unverified.
fields.missing: All accused names, cheque/amount/signatory, complaint, summons, settlement application and post-April order sheets. No inference that election/parking merits were decided.

title: Tower-11/12 sub-lease registry case
text: Home-buyers sought sub-lease execution and a decision on their 12 February 2026 representation. The High Court disposed of the writ on 9 April 2026 without a view on the merits, asking the Authority to decide within three months of the certified copy. On 15 July 2026 the Authority directed the builder to pay lease rent and, within three months, obtain completion for Towers 11 and 12 and execute sub-leases for their home-buyers generally.

fields.parties: Sourabh Thukral and 28 others v. State of U.P. and 3 others (cause title as quoted)
fields.forum: Allahabad High Court; Greater Noida Authority
fields.prayers: As quoted in the Authority's order: sub-lease execution within a fixed time, and a decision on the 12 February 2026 representation. Counsel confined the prayer to the second.
fields.outcome: A direction to decide, not a registry order. The three-month registry window comes from the Authority's order and depends on a completion certificate that had not been issued. In May 2026 residents said registry had not started.
fields.missing: Signed High Court order with neutral citation; the petition; proof of completion and sub-lease execution after October 2026.

title: Current election-control challenge
text: Filed 29 October; registered 3 November. CNR UPHC056633602026, filing CIVIL12/276142/2026, diary 266021102026. Official record confirms institution and parties.

fields.parties: Panchsheel Hynish Apartment Owners and Another; Vinod Negi v State, Deputy Registrar Firm, Election Officer and Anuj Kumar
fields.prayers: NOT OBTAINED. Descriptions of what this petition seeks, circulating among residents, remain unverified until the filed petition is seen.
